purpose: Canonical evidence file for 2025. Only sourced records in this file are eligible for later card scoring.

records.title: Bybit suffers record $1.5 billion crypto theft
records.summary: Attackers compromised the Safe wallet interface used during a routine Bybit cold-to-warm wallet transfer and moved roughly 401,000 ETH, worth nearly $1.5 billion at the time.
records.significance: The Bybit breach became the largest crypto theft ever recorded at the time and a defining example of supply-chain/interface compromise against centralized custody.

records.title: North Korean attackers are linked to the Bybit heist
records.summary: Bybit and blockchain investigators linked the February theft to the North Korean state-backed Lazarus Group/DPRK-linked operators based on attack infrastructure, laundering behavior and forensic indicators.
records.significance: The attribution made the largest crypto heist part of a broader nation-state cybercrime story rather than an ordinary exchange breach.

records.title: United States establishes Strategic Bitcoin Reserve
records.summary: A US executive order established a Strategic Bitcoin Reserve funded initially with finally forfeited government BTC. The order directs that BTC deposited into the reserve shall not be sold and permits study of budget-neutral acquisition strategies.
records.significance: A government that had historically auctioned seized Bitcoin formally adopted a policy of retaining forfeited BTC as a national reserve asset.

sources.title: White House — Establishment of the Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and United States Digital Asset Stockpile

records.title: United States establishes Digital Asset Stockpile
records.summary: The same executive order created a separate United States Digital Asset Stockpile for finally forfeited digital assets other than Bitcoin.
records.significance: The split between a Bitcoin-specific reserve and a broader non-Bitcoin stockpile created a new formal distinction in US government treatment of crypto assets.

sources.title: White House — Strategic Bitcoin Reserve and Digital Asset Stockpile Executive Order

records.title: Ethereum activates Pectra
records.summary: Ethereum's Pectra upgrade activated at epoch 364,032. It added smart-contract-like capabilities for EOAs, raised the maximum effective validator balance to 2,048 ETH and increased blob throughput.
records.significance: Pectra was one of Ethereum's largest post-Merge upgrades, improving wallet UX, validator operations and rollup data capacity.

records.title: United States enacts GENIUS Act stablecoin framework
records.summary: The GENIUS Act was signed into US law on July 18, 2025, establishing a federal regulatory framework for payment stablecoins.
records.significance: The law became a major milestone in moving dollar stablecoins from a patchwork regulatory environment toward a dedicated federal framework.

records.title: SEC permits in-kind creations and redemptions for crypto ETPs
records.summary: The SEC approved orders allowing authorized participants to create and redeem crypto-asset ETP shares in kind rather than only through cash transactions.
records.significance: The change made US spot Bitcoin and Ether ETP mechanics more similar to other commodity ETPs and reduced a structural limitation imposed at the products' 2024 launches.

sources.title: SEC — Permits In-Kind Creations and Redemptions for Crypto ETPs

records.title: Ethereum activates Fusaka
records.summary: Ethereum's Fusaka upgrade activated at slot 13,164,544 and introduced PeerDAS alongside execution- and consensus-layer scaling improvements and a framework for blob-parameter-only forks.
records.significance: PeerDAS let validators sample blob data instead of requiring every validator to download all of it, enabling Ethereum to scale rollup data throughput more efficiently.
